## Description

Combines Gaussian Process priors with physical differential equation models (Latent Force Models) to enforce smooth physical dynamics on latent macroeconomic drivers of term structure models.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon yield curve forecasting, sovereign bond relative value trading.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Desks, Sovereign Wealth Allocators.

## Required data

Sovereign yield curve tenor pricing, inflation data, policy rate time series.

## Caveats

Gaussian Process kernel matrix inversion scales $O(N^3)$; sparse GP approximations required for long time horizons.
